test_rows_index_query: test the RowsIndex class to query parquet files by offset and length using libviewer
test_rows_index_empty_dataset: test the RowsIndex class handles empty parquet datasets and returns zero rows
test_rows_index_schema_mismatch: test the RowsIndex class raises SchemaMismatchError when parquet files have inconsistent schemas
test_rows_index_too_big_rows: test the RowsIndex class raises TooBigRows when rows exceed the max scan size limit
test_parquet_export_is_partial: test the parquet_export_is_partial function to check if a parquet URL is a partial export
